description: How to build an app with these charts, from the guide this package ships. Local and free: no network, no credentials. topic 'fabric-app' (the default) is what a Microsoft Fabric App on the Rayfin data app template needs: what to pull, generating, wiring in React, the Fabric App section and the time-savers. 'all' is the whole guide, including Blazor. 'chart-shapes' lists every chart type with the columns, limits and renderers it needs. Read it before the first generate_chart call.
name: get_guide
title: Read the build guide
